# Benchmarks

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "fcms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "fcms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "fcms-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "fcms-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "fcms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

FCMS is benchmarked against the finite-cylinder Jech et al. reference family stored in `benchmark_ts` [@Jech_2015]. The full cylindrical grid is used for each boundary condition.

| Boundary | Max abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Mean abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Elapsed (s) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `fixed_rigid` | 0.19454 | 0.00914 | 0.01 |
| `pressure_release` | 0.00780 | 0.00263 | 0.03 |
| `gas_filled` | 0.00499 | 0.00245 | 0.05 |
| `liquid_filled` | 0.11453 | 0.00512 | 0.05 |

The largest residuals occur in fixed-rigid and liquid-filled null neighborhoods. Pressure-release and gas-filled runs remain benchmark-close across the full grid.

## Modal-limit sensitivity

| Boundary | `m_limit` | Max abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Mean abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Elapsed (s) |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `liquid_filled` | default rule | 0.11453 | 0.00512 | 0.05 |
| `liquid_filled` | `20` | 0.12618 | 0.00547 | 0.09 |
| `liquid_filled` | `10` | 43.09805 | 4.29035 | 0.01 |

The reduced cap check is a convergence guard. It is not a recommended speed knob for production comparisons.
